claims.drop: Darnell Washington (25, TE, PIT blocker; yr-4, 69 season)
claims.why: Saquon is week-to-week (hamstring, not considered long-term) and Bigsby is headed to IR after core-muscle surgery, so Shipley's 166k adds have a real cause. He's the top PHI back available, and Love's new ankle issue (Q) makes your RB2 shaky in a win-now league. Sleeper projects him at only 6.2, so this is a speculative bid ($9 = $7 sober + early-season aggression), not a role-bet price. Washington is a stalled year-4 blocking TE behind LaPorta, Loveland and Henry, which puts him in the right dynasty drop bucket.
